  "agent": "onboarding-specialist",

  "task": {{ JSON.stringify('Auto-discover Client Brain for ' + ($('Validate Deal Data').item.json.client_name || 'new client') + ' (industry: ' + ($('Validate Deal Data').item.json.industry || 'unknown') + ', location: ' + ($('Validate Deal Data').item.json.location || 'UNKNOWN') + ', website: ' + ($('Validate Deal Data').item.json.website || 'unknown') + ', client_id: ' + ($('Validate Deal Data').item.json.client_id || '') + ').' + String.fromCharCode(10) + '' + String.fromCharCode(10) + 'Research · brand voice + ICP + competitive landscape + VOC. ' + ($('Validate Deal Data').item.json.location ? 'GEOGRAPHIC ANCHOR (MANDATORY · GIVEN — DO NOT INFER IT): the client operates in ' + $('Validate Deal Data').item.json.location + '. Research ONLY that market. It is a SERIOUS ERROR to return competitors from a different city, region or country, or to research a similarly-named company somewhere else.' : 'GEOGRAPHIC ANCHOR: the client location was NOT provided and there is no reliable way to infer it. Do NOT guess a country. Try to establish the location from evidence; if you cannot, SAY SO explicitly in the output and do NOT invent a market.') + ' You may ADD competitors from the same local market, but you must NEVER change region.' + String.fromCharCode(10) + '' + String.fromCharCode(10) + 'CRITICAL FINAL STEP · when research is complete, you MUST CALL the emit_discovery_output tool with your structured findings. + String.fromCharCode(10) + '' + String.fromCharCode(10) + (
